response.sql:
SELECT AVG(rating_avg_duration) AS avg_rating_avg_duration,
       AVG(rating_avg_ratio) AS avg_rating_avg_ratio
FROM (
  SELECT rating,
         AVG(rental_duration) AS rating_avg_duration,
         AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS rating_avg_ratio
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
) AS per_rating;

assumptions.assumption: Each rating contributes equally to the final averages, as requested by averaging the per-rating averages. SQL AVG ignores NULL values in the ratio expression.
